churn.alignment: exact scientific descriptors and counts within condition; cross-condition align only approved descriptor mapping, never version-dependent feature IDs
churn.cohort: independently equivalent pairs only, per view; incomplete/truncated observations remain qualified
churn.details: inserted/deleted descriptors and instances; shared-descriptor count deltas

cohort.candidate_duplicate_physical_function: retain lexicographically smallest graph_id; conflicting judgments fail
cohort.same_canonical_file_bytes: deduplicate exact byte copies with identical physical provenance only
cohort.source: all 218 independently frozen labeled pairs; no score-based admission
cohort.step9: separate optional discovery-only supplementary cohort; not part of primary Step 8 evaluation

A.input: same validated embedded LocalSubgraphDocument as B
A.name: No semantic canonicalization research control
A.restriction: Separate source-traceable adapter; no forged canonical documents or bypassed frozen validation; explicitly shared structural role/order preprocessing

distributions.quantile: linear interpolation h=(n-1)*p; null for empty cohort

features.feature_parity: Same descriptors/families/counting/budgets except explicitly approved normalization values; B must match frozen engine
features.observability: separate diagnostics; never affects semantic scores

gates.revision: new immutable protocol version and explicit rationale/authorization; never overwrite
gates.step10_2: No empirical A/B scores until tested comparability is admitted; unsupported A blocks full acceptance

metrics: Spearman correlation of average tie ranks
rank_stability.n_one: normalized rank difference zero; correlation undefined/null
rank_stability.primary_dimension: A vs B identical judged gallery
rank_stability.secondary_dimensions: compiler/optimization or Step9 only where independently justified identical reference IDs exist; otherwise unsupported
rank_stability.ties: average ranks for correlation; graph-id tiebreak only for deterministic topK

retrieval.direction: each endpoint of an admitted undirected judgment is a query
retrieval.gallery: query-specific judged references only, same split
retrieval.hit: per query: 1 if any known positive in top K else 0; named Hit@K separately
retrieval.macro: arithmetic mean over eligible queries within split and K; emit query IDs and denominator
retrieval.mrr: mean over eligible scored queries of reciprocal rank of first known relevant reference
retrieval.null_candidate: entire query excluded from scored retrieval; keep original gallery and disclose coverage
retrieval.paired_conditions: identical query/reference sets and judgments; complete common cohort only
retrieval.recall: per query: number of known relevant references in top K / total known relevant references in full judged gallery
retrieval.retrieval_false_top1: non_equivalent top1 / eligible scored queries; unknown relevance unsupported

runtime.cache: outputs not reused as zero-cost execution; shared Ghidra upstream cost excluded and disclosed
runtime.cohort: all eligible matched A/B graphs and pairs, deterministic IDs
runtime.memory: optional; unsupported unless common verified peak RSS method
runtime.profile: same locked debug engine and same research adapter runtime; report language/startup overhead as confound
runtime.replay: scientific outputs byte-identical; timings excluded from scientific digests
runtime.summary: raw repetitions, median and linear-interpolated quantiles, failure counts

design.scope: judged-gallery / limited-judgment evaluation of benign function equivalence

scoring.aggregate: unweighted arithmetic mean of comparable semantic views
scoring.numeric: IEEE754 binary64, exact integer Jaccard sums, no rounding before ranking; report full JSON precision
scoring.paired_components: require identical comparable-view sets in A/B; otherwise separate condition coverage, not a paired delta

threshold.algorithm: maximize balanced accuracy on discovery comparable pairs; candidates = distinct discovery scores plus reject_all; score >= threshold is match; ties choose largest threshold (reject_all largest)
threshold.false_match_rate: negative scored pairs predicted match / all eligible scored negative pairs
threshold.paired_cohort: same discovery pair IDs and comparable component sets for A/B calibration
threshold.positive_prediction: score >= finite threshold; reject_all predicts no matches

uncertainty.cluster: connected frozen source/artifact/declared near-duplicate components, not independent pairs
uncertainty.if_supported: paired cluster bootstrap 2000 replicates seed 101; percentile interval 2.5/97.5; undefined replicates disclosed
uncertainty.primary: descriptive cluster-macro summaries; no inferential intervals when <10 independent components
uncertainty.significance: no unqualified significance or population inference
